other_failure_modes.name: Leaky Feature Selection Before Cross-Validation
other_failure_modes.description: Feature selection is applied to the entire training dataset prior to running cross-validation. Because the feature selection model is trained on the full training set, it evaluates relationships using data that will later act as held-out validation sets in the CV folds, resulting in overly optimistic cross-validation scores.

sel_lgb.fit(X_selection, y_selection)
importances = sel_lgb.feature_importances_
...
selected_features = [valid_cols[i] for i in top_indices]

summary: The agent provides a robust and comprehensive solution with advanced feature engineering, safe out-of-fold target encoding, and an SLSQP-optimized ensemble. However, it performs LightGBM-based feature selection on the full training set before cross-validation, which leaks validation fold information into the feature choice and compromises the integrity of the CV score. Additionally, it relies exclusively on RMSE for model evaluation.
